items.line: PopBase reports that Doja Cat changed a lyric of "Paint The Town Red" at her Dallas show after the Democratic election win, singing "I don’t care I paint the town BLUE." Not checked here.
Netflix announces "Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure", a new series set for 2028, with the line "Before Hawkins, there was Marion." Fans reply in the thread.
DegenTracker_ says Utah has criminally charged the CEO and COO of Kalshi with 13 counts of illegal gambling. Not checked here.

Thomas Massie asks Grok whether F-35 jets flew over a Washington press conference about Epstein and drowned out survivors who were speaking. Grok is made by xAI, which also makes the model that gathers this site’s posts. Not checked here.
_InfoGram_ posts what it presents as an exchange: JD Vance blaming the Iran war for the Republican losses, and Zohran Mamdani answering that Vance started the war and can end it. Not checked here.

Elon Musk posts "Everyone is using Grok @Bot" with a link, quoting a user’s post about a Grok Bot device. Grok is made by xAI, which also makes the model that gathers this site’s posts, and Musk is its owner.

The White House account quotes a statement from President Trump saying the stock market had one of its worst days because of the election results and blaming Democrats for drops in 401(k)s. Not checked here.
A post with attached media says there will be 13 years of good luck for anyone who does not ignore "the little kitten".
xdNiBoR says the next SpaceX data center will be in Cochise, Arizona, about 6 GW across nine buildings, with no industrial water use and no on-site gas power. Not checked here.
ridzieluvbts360 says the C-drama trend did not start with "Hidden Love" but with "My Girlfriend Is an Alien" and "Put Your Head on My Shoulder".
gloccnim says they did not realise how well their parents raised them until they were around other people. The post has attached media.
KoomseFN shares the loot route their squad took to get the Pirate Token, saying it yields over 400 chests a game. A video is attached.
Fabrizio Romano reports that José Mourinho, asked whether he is tough or soft on Vini Jr., said he is "20% tough and 80% soft" with him.
LegionHoops reports that Paige Bueckers and Azzi Fudd announced on the Fudd Around Pod that they have broken up.
Formula 1 says it is saddened by the death of 1980 World Champion Alan Jones, who made his F1 debut at the 1975 Spanish Grand Prix with Hesketh.
frankiebyler_ tells Taylor Swift her album is at Goodwill for $1.99, saying they walked in and saw it. A photo or video is attached. Not checked here.
kchartsmaster reports that NCT DREAM released a music video teaser for "Boogie Woogie".
DiscussingFilm shares the first clip from "Ray Gunn", directed by Brad Bird. It says the film follows a private detective in a case involving aliens and murder, and arrives December 18 on Netflix.
Director S. S. Rajamouli praises the film "Ramayana", saying Ranbir as Rama, Yash as Ravana and Sai Pallavi as Sita are strong, and congratulates its makers.
Pubity reports that Eiji Aonuma, a Zelda developer since 1998, says Nintendo’s choice not to do mass layoffs helps it make great games because long-term staff can teach junior developers.
Gabriele_Corno posts attached media with the caption "Sometimes all you need is an outside cat to show some love".

Kaitlan Collins reports that Trump announces Stephen Miller will become his chief of staff. The White House posts Trump’s statement: Miller starts Monday, November 9, and Susie Wiles moves to the Trump Political Operation.
WarMonitor3 says Iran is starting to hand out iodine tablets to residents near nuclear sites, and reads it as a sign that large strikes could be coming. Not checked here.
nicksortor says three police officers were shot just outside Denver, Colorado, and that their conditions were unknown when it posted early on November 6 (UTC). Not checked here.
WatcherGuru says Japan’s Nikkei 225 has officially entered a bear market as stocks fall. Not checked here.
Polymarket says Mamdani proposes banning Amazon from using third-party delivery contractors, so it would have to hire drivers directly. Not checked here.

Elon Musk says Tesla has no government contracts, that President Trump ended federal incentives for electric vehicles, and that SpaceX would cancel any government contract the government does not want. Not checked here.

InternetH0F says Tesla is reportedly ending Cybertruck production because of poor sales, citing Reuters. Cointelegraph says Musk said production at Giga Texas will wind down by mid-2027 to make room for Cybercabs. Not checked here.
Discord shows a side-by-side test on mobile: its current Android app on the left and a new version it is building in Rust on the right.
Al Jazeera English reports that more than 100 activists broke into a Microsoft data centre construction site in Amsterdam and hung anti-AI banners, the start of two days of protests in 16 countries.
Elon Musk says SpaceX revenue this quarter alone will be substantially higher than NASA’s entire annual budget. Not checked here.
NASA shows the sunshade that will fly on NEO Surveyor, a spacecraft meant to spot nearby asteroids and comets that ground-based telescopes might miss.

Igor Bobic reports that Chris Murphy is out of the hospital. Quoting Murphy, he says Murphy was diagnosed with a small bleed in the thalamus region of his brain and will spend several weeks at a rehabilitation center.

Aura_lixx quotes an engineer it says works at Anthropic as saying people should build systems that prompt themselves rather than prompt Opus 5.5. Claude, the model writing this page, is made by Anthropic. Not checked here.
